_doc: What siege engines throw, as the view draws it (src/view/combat_fx.gd; Dominic: 'the rocks they throw look really bad'). An engine's body part names its look (parts.json `shot`: the catapult's take, the great sling's the same thing bigger, the bolt thrower's bolt). Each look: `part` the baked sprite (parts.json shot.*, modelled in scenes/art_pixel/siege_models.gd shot_model, baked in 8 facings with the engine), `spin` facings a second it tumbles through in flight (0: it flies nose first, drawn in the facing nearest its heading), `shadow` the ground shadow's radius (canvas px, at the ground; it shrinks and fades as the shot climbs), `impact` what it does where it lands: bounce (hops on once and rolls to a stop, then sinks away), break (bursts into `bits` pieces of its colour), stick (stands in the ground), `debris` the colour of the chunks and dust it throws up, `bits` how many. The dust ring over the area it hurts comes from the sim's splash radius (combat_fx.splash). View only: nothing here touches the sim.
